candidates.title: One-command ChatGPT harvest completion
candidates.problem: Operators run many harvest commands manually in sequence after ChatGPT push.
candidates.newCapability: Single orchestrator: ingest → duplication-preflight → sync-derived → validate → publication packet.
candidates.whyNow: Protocol Git→L pipeline shipped; ingest paths exist piecemeal.
candidates.nextProof: Dry-run script listing commands + receipts without mutation; compare to manual closeout on one harvest id.

candidates.title: Automatic harvest branch watcher
candidates.problem: Operators may not know when new ChatGPT drafts land on branch.
candidates.newCapability: Notify + schema check + duplication proposal on new findings commits.
candidates.whyNow: GHA move-to-L exists but no operator notification layer.
candidates.nextProof: Document gap between existing GHA and desired notify; spike GitHub issue comment or webhook.

candidates.title: Tiered closeout classifier T0–T3

candidates.noveltyNotes: Tier table now in both ChatGPT protocols.
candidates.nextProof: Retro-label 5 recent harvest ids with tier; measure section count vs value.
